edges.reason: The white_bed is inside the sandstone temple; locating chiseled_sandstone pillars guides the agent to enter the structure
The dark_oak_sign is on the interior back wall of the sandstone temple, visible only after entering the structure
Crafting wooden_axe requires planks and sticks derived from jungle_log (log → 4 planks → sticks + planks → axe)
Kelp grows underwater in the ocean pool; the agent must navigate to the water body before looking down to spot kelp
The blue_orchid is at the ocean shore edge (5,1,9); the agent reaches it by navigating toward the ocean area
Light_gray_concrete_powder blocks are placed along the beach adjacent to the ocean, accessible after reaching the shore
Mining magenta_wool exposes lapis_ore hidden directly beneath it, providing lapis_lazuli needed for crafting lapis_block
Mining black_wool reveals additional lapis_ore underneath; combined with magenta_wool ore, provides enough lapis_lazuli for the block

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate north to the sandstone temple and observe the chiseled_sandstone pillars. Target is the chiseled_sandstone block at (-3, 1, -10) relative to spawn. Max distance 6 requires actual navigation from spawn (~10.4 blocks away). Facing tolerance 60° ensures the player is looking toward the temple.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must enter the sandstone temple and observe the white bed inside. Target is the bed foot at (0, 1, -7) relative to spawn. Max distance 4 ensures the player is inside or at the entrance of the temple, facing the bed.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must enter the temple and look at the dark oak wall sign on the interior back wall. Target is the sign at (1, 2, -9) relative to spawn. Max distance 5 requires the player to be inside the temple. Facing tolerance 60° ensures the player is looking toward the back wall where the sign is mounted.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate east to the jungle grove and observe the jungle logs. Target is the central jungle log at (8, 2, 0) relative to spawn. Max distance 6 requires actual navigation from spawn (~8.2 blocks away). Facing tolerance 60° models the player seeing the jungle tree.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden_axe places it in the player's inventory. The player must chop jungle_log, convert to planks and sticks, then craft the axe at the crafting table. The crafted item ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task in an artificial scene without a true ocean biome tag. The player must navigate south to the water body. Target is the center of the water area at (0, 0, 11) relative to spawn. Max distance 5 requires the player to walk from spawn (11 blocks away) to within 5 blocks of the water center. Facing tolerance 60° ensures the player is observing the water.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must look into the ocean water and observe the kelp growing underwater. Target is the kelp_plant at (0, -1, 11) relative to spawn (below water surface). Max distance 4 requires the player to be at the water's edge. Facing tolerance 45° (tighter than ocean) ensures the player is specifically looking down into the water at the kelp location, differentiating this from the broader 'find ocean' task.

Uses inventory_has because mining a blue_orchid (breaking the flower) drops the blue_orchid item into the player's inventory. Flowers break instantly with any tool or bare hands and drop themselves. The blue orchid is at (5,1,9) near the ocean shore.

Uses inventory_has because mining light_gray_concrete_powder drops the block itself into the player's inventory. Concrete powder is a gravity-affected block that drops itself when broken with any tool. Three blocks are available on the beach.

Uses inventory_has because mining magenta_wool drops the wool block into the player's inventory. Wool drops itself when broken by any means (shears are fastest but not required for the drop). The player has shears available. Two magenta_wool blocks are at (-8, 1-2, 0).

Uses inventory_has because mining black_wool drops the wool block into the player's inventory. Wool drops itself when broken by any means. The player has shears available. Two black_wool blocks are at (-9, 1-2, 0), adjacent to the magenta wool.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a lapis_block (9 lapis_lazuli in a 3×3 grid) places it in the player's inventory. The player must first mine lapis_ore with the iron_pickaxe (which drops 4-9 lapis_lazuli per ore), then craft the block at the crafting table. Five lapis_ore blocks guarantee sufficient material. The crafted item is not in starting inventory.

scene_description: A compact multi-biome hub centered around the player spawn. North (z=-6 to -10): sandstone temple with chiseled sandstone corner pillars, white bed inside, and dark oak wall sign on interior back wall. East (x=6-10): jungle grove with jungle logs and leaves for crafting a wooden axe. South (z=6-14): sand beach transitioning to ocean water pool with kelp underwater, blue orchid at shore edge, and light gray concrete powder on beach. West (x=-7 to -10): stone brick platform with magenta/black wool blocks stacked atop hidden lapis ore, plus one visible lapis ore at eye level as a hint. Crafting table placed near spawn at (1,0,1) with player given shears and iron pickaxe.
task_text: Explore a multi-biome hub: find the sandstone temple with its bed and sign, locate jungle logs to craft a wooden axe, discover the ocean with kelp and shore flowers, mine wool blocks to uncover lapis for crafting a lapis block, and gather concrete powder from the beach.
design_notes: Final validated layout. North temple: solid sandstone shell with interior air carve (-2,1,-9 to 2,3,-7), leaving back wall at z=-10 solid for wall sign support. Sign at (1,2,-9) attaches to sandstone at (1,2,-10). Doorway at (0,1-2,-6) for entry. East jungle: 5 jungle_logs with leaves within 4 blocks preventing decay. South ocean: sand base with water source blocks, kelp on sand pedestals with water above. Blue orchid at (5,1,9) on sand outside water fill range. West wool/lapis: wool at y=1-2 atop lapis_ore at y=0 and y=-1, plus visible lapis_ore at (-10,1,0) as hint. Player given shears + iron_pickaxe. Crafting table at (1,0,1) avoids spawn collision.
